fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled entrance off Day St at the NW corner of the property. 2025-12 Street View shows a wide entrance driveway with a perimeter wall/fence and a defined checkpoint where the drive enters the truck yard.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small tan/beige guard booth (~1-vehicle footprint, windows on multiple sides) sits beside the inbound lane just inside the entrance. Clearly visible in 2025-12 Street View from two angles. Staffed guarded entry.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False — a physical guard booth is present, so check-in is staffed rather than kiosk/app.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: The entrance drive runs a long, deep uphill approach from the Day St gate to the dock yard along the north face — comfortably holds a 3+ truck queue inside the property.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Wide paved internal truck drive between the gate and the north dock apron provides inside-the-gate holding room.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide gate apron and generous internal paved width along the north truck drive; physical room exists to add an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: 613,200 sq ft DC (UNFI's largest Western-region facility, opened 2008). Long single dock bank runs the full north face of the building with trailers backed in across it; comfortably 50+, estimated ~95.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Striped/unstriped trailer parking along the north truck yard holds parked trailers without tractors; 25-50 band on UNFI's own yard. (Note: a much larger trailer lot NW across the road belongs to a separate adjacent tenant and is excluded.)
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage rows along the north side of the property, separate from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside the dense Moreno Valley / Inland Empire industrial fabric — surrounded by other large DCs and industrial buildings. Urban.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box (~245m x ~499m) yields ~30 acres for the UNFI parcel.
fieldNotes.address: Roster lists 22450 Day St; the on-site office address marker reads 14160 Day St and the building is the correct 613,200 sq ft UNFI Western-region DC. The 22450 figure appears to be a stale/incorrect roster address — site identity is confirmed by building size, layout and the UNFI office signage.
